notes:
Account summary: ZenWave is a large consumer marketplace (marketplace + first-party storefronts). Big focus on automating contact center ops: agent-assist + guarantee-safe tool-calls to backend systems (tickets, refunds, escalations). They currently use Zendesk + internal Refunds API + ServiceNow for escalations.

Key business drivers:
- Reduce AHT for agents (current avg 9m) and shrink refund handling time from 18m to <4m.
- Offload routine refunds and simple status checks to an assistant with deterministic tool-calling (must be auditable).
- Survive burst events (Black Friday-like spikes). expected peak: ~900 concurrent chat sessions, target 200 ticket creations/sec in bursts.

Integration requirements / technical asks:
- Tool calls: create_ticket (Zendesk v2 API), update_ticket, refund_charge (internal API), escalate_case (ServiceNow). All calls must support idempotency tokens and strict request/response audit logs.
- Refund policy: human-approval threshold for >$200 (configurable). Want sandbox mode where LLM returns proposed API payloads for human approval before execution.
- Observability: per-request token cost, per-route latency, correlation_id across chat->toolcall->payment.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM, KMS for secrets, strict retention controls, SOC2 compliance proof required.
- Network: prefer VPC peering for private plane, option for Dedicated for guaranteed throughput.
- Determinism: require structured function-calling output (JSON schema) from model; unsafe freeform not acceptable for money ops.

Quotes/highlights from meetings:
- "If the model touches money we need a full audit trail and manual hold for exceptions." — VP Support
- "We want to offload 40% of refunds to automated flow in 3 months, but no mistakes on charge reversals." — Head of Ops

POC scope & success criteria:
- 6 week POC: wire up Zendesk create/update flows + refunds sandbox to internal staging payment system.
- Success criteria: 95% correct payload generation for refunds (schema + idempotency), avg API creation latency <250ms p50, human-in-the-loop flow validated for >$200 refunds.
- Must run a simulated Black Friday spike (synthetic load) and show graceful degradation + automatic fallback to read-only assistant when refund API rate limited.

Risks called out by their engineering team:
- Race conditions: concurrent agent edits -> need optimistic locking on ticket updates.
- Refund double-charges if retries not deduped by idempotency key.
- Telemetry gaps: need end-to-end request IDs to debug tool-calls.

Sales/ops notes (shorthand):
- Pricing asks: reserved capacity pricing + overage model; will compare against ServiceNow + internal infra cost.
- Legal: requires data residency agreement for EU buyers on platform; currently NA HQ but EU customer base.
- Next meeting: security deep-dive w/ infra lead 2025-03-24.

Attachments: POC deck (drive/zenwave/POC_pricing_deck_v2.pdf), security Q&A doc.

Short-term next actions:
- Send tailored POC runbook + checklist by 2025-03-20 (AE).
- Engineering sync to confirm refund API idempotency semantics (SE + ZenWave eng).
- Get SSO SAML metadata from ZenWave to start security review.
